description: Implementation of QueryGL classes and related query handling logic for OpenGL in the ANGLE project, including query result merging, query management, and synchronization mechanisms.

classes.name: QueryGL
classes.description: Base class for OpenGL query objects.

classes.name: StandardQueryGL
classes.description: Handles standard OpenGL queries, including begin, end, result retrieval, and merging results.

classes.name: SyncQueryGL
classes.description: Handles synchronization queries, supporting fence sync and occlusion queries.

classes.name: SyncProviderGLSync
classes.description: Sync provider using fence sync objects.

methods.name: MergeQueryResults
methods.description: Merges two query results based on query type.

methods.name: StandardQueryGL::getResult
methods.description: Overloaded methods to get query result as different types.

methods.name: StandardQueryGL::isResultAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the query result is available.

methods.name: StandardQueryGL::flush
methods.description: Flushes pending queries and updates results.

methods.name: SyncProviderGL::flush
methods.description: Abstract method to flush sync provider.

methods.name: SyncQueryGL::getResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result of the sync query.

methods.name: SyncQueryGL::isResultAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the sync result is available.

methods.name: SyncQueryGL::getResultBase
methods.description: Retrieves the boolean result of the sync query.
